export interface Job {requestId: string; name: string;}
export function response(context: ActiveContext, payload: unknown) {return {requestId:context.requestId,payload};}
export function work(context: RequestContext, job: Job) {const child=forkContext(context,'worker');return describeJob(job,child);}

export function handle(trace: string,user: string,job: Job) {const context=createContext(trace,user);return {context,headers:headers(context),logs:logFields(context),body:response(context,work(context,job))};}
